rationale: 1 blocking finding: edge-case lens flagged and source-verified a real gap in the on_llm_end redundant-finalize guard — _build_routing_update_fields() carries forward existing_thought.metadata into has_new_routing before checking for actually-new routing info, so a truly redundant on_llm_end after an earlier partial-metadata call still resends the thought instead of being suppressed. 1 finding deferred as pre-existing and out of this change's stated scope (on_llm_error's unconditional overwrite of an already-finalized thought, confirmed untouched by this diff via git history). 4 edge-case candidates dismissed as noise: unresolved-model storage retention is the deliberate, explicitly-documented design this fix preserves and is bounded to a single execution's storage lifetime; the concurrent-on_llm_end race is unreachable because langgraph_agent.py:894 drives a single synchronous `for chunk in stream:` loop with no concurrent dispatch; _persisted_ids unbounded growth is bounded to one ThoughtConsumer instance's per-execution lifetime with negligible practical size; and future.cancelled()-before-.exception() is unreachable since no code path in this repo calls consumer_executor.shutdown(cancel_futures=True) or future.cancel(). All 15 acceptance criteria from lens-acceptance.md passed with no fail/partial; standards-review.json reported all three rows pass with no blocking findings and coverage_gap: false.

findings.title: Stale metadata triggers redundant thought resend
findings.problem: _build_routing_update_fields() seeds its `metadata` dict from `existing_thought.metadata` whenever that is already non-empty, before checking whether the current call's response_tier/response_cost carry anything new. `has_new_routing = bool(routing_fields or metadata)` (line 227) then reads True purely because of that carried-over prior metadata, even when this on_llm_end call has no new routing information at all.
findings.impact: A run_id that received partial routing metadata (e.g. classifier cost only, no tier) on an earlier on_llm_end call, followed by a genuinely redundant call for the same run_id, bypasses the already_finalized-and-not-has_new_routing early return (lines 229-231) and gets resent to the client as a duplicate finalized thought (empty message, unchanged metadata) before storage is cleared — the exact double-finalize resend behavior this fix was written to suppress, violating the stated acceptance criterion that a redundant on_llm_end must not resend.
findings.recommendation: Derive has_new_routing from the raw response_tier/response_cost inputs only, e.g. `has_new_routing = response_tier is not None or response_cost is not None`, rather than from the metadata dict returned by _build_routing_update_fields, which already carries forward existing_thought's prior state regardless of whether anything new arrived.
